import math
import unittest

from solution import summarize_samples


class OnceIterable:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.calls = 0

    def __iter__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.calls > 1:
            raise AssertionError("iterated more than once")
        return iter(self.values)


class SummarizeSamplesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_statistics_order_keys_and_non_mutation(self):
        samples = [[1, 2, 3], [-2.0, 2.0]]
        original = [row[:] for row in samples]
        result = summarize_samples(samples)
        self.assertEqual(samples, original)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
        expected_keys = {
            "count", "minimum", "maximum", "span", "mean",
            "variance", "deviation", "z_scores"
        }
        self.assertEqual(set(result[0]), expected_keys)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["count"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["minimum"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["maximum"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["span"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["mean"], 2)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result[0]["variance"], 2 / 3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result[0]["deviation"], math.sqrt(2 / 3))
        for actual, expected in zip(
                result[0]["z_scores"],
                [-math.sqrt(1.5), 0.0, math.sqrt(1.5)]):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(actual, expected)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["z_scores"], [-1.0, 1.0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["z_scores"], result[1]["z_scores"])

    def test_constant_and_singleton_samples(self):
        result = summarize_samples([[5, 5, 5], [7]])
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["variance"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["deviation"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["z_scores"], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["span"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["z_scores"], [0.0])

    def test_generators_are_consumed_once(self):
        first = OnceIterable([1, 3])
        second = OnceIterable([10])
        outer = OnceIterable([first, second])
        result = summarize_samples(outer)
        self.assertEqual([item["mean"] for item in result], [2, 10])
        self.assertEqual((outer.calls, first.calls, second.calls), (1, 1, 1))

    def test_result_does_not_alias_input(self):
        row = [1, 2]
        result = summarize_samples([row])
        result[0]["z_scores"].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(row, [1, 2])

    def test_rejects_empty_or_malformed_input(self):
        cases = [
            [], [[], [1]], [[1], []], [[True]], [[math.nan]],
            [[math.inf]], [["1"]], None,
        ]
        for samples in cases:
            with self.subTest(samples=samples):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    summarize_samples(samples)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
